text_block_list.text: Gah! I thought this one was in the bag!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
That's what you're thinking, right?! But
don't you
fret! I have luck on my side!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
When I saw my time in today's race, my
lucky
number happened to be there!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Which means I'm definitely going to win
next
time... In fact, consider it already
won!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Yep! I am the lucky-musume after all!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I'm riding on a treasure ship with the
seven gods
of fortune, so sit back and
watch the luck come
rolling in!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Ah, haha! But of course! I'll give it my all!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
As you can see, I take these things very
seriously!
Serious is my middle name!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on a minute! Where did my
left cleat
go?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
No no no... That's my lucky cleat!
Wh-where'd it
go?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
More challenges are sure to lie ahead.
We resolve
to work harder to bring more
fortunate results in
the future.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Crash! Splash! More and more treasures, riding the waves my way!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
